And here she is, the surfer everybody has been talking about this season. She made her debut in twenty twenty-two, when she was fourteen, and since then she has entered nineteen events. She has won two titles, both of them last year, and she has already made three finals so far this season. One detail for you: she has never surfed this reef in a competition. Never. So whatever happens in the next thirty minutes, it is her first time out there with a jersey on.

People always ask about the background. It was swimming, actually. I swam competitively until I was eleven and then I found a board and that was it. I made my debut at fifteen and I competed for twelve years. The highlight was the national title in twenty nineteen, no question about it. I retired in twenty twenty-two, because of the shoulder, and honestly it was the right moment. I coach juniors now, and I have not missed the travelling once.
